source_name: RxNorm Current Prescribable Content Monthly Release
published_access_statement: The official RxNorm files page labels the Current Prescribable Content monthly release as no-license-required.

observed_access_result.interpretation: Both dated and generic Current Prescribable candidates, plus the full-current control, redirected to UTS login and returned HTML in this environment; no ZIP payload was downloaded.

decision: Do not treat the release-page statement as evidence that this program obtained the payload. No terminology source manifest, row count, checksum, or benchmark mapping is created.
next_gate: Resolve the official download-access discrepancy or obtain an authorized release delivery; then retain the raw release outside git and produce a complete source manifest.
